7898.title: Launcher spawn failure leaves exit wait unresolved
7898.rootCauseOneLine: A failed spawn emits error, but the shared exit waiter only settles on exit; the observed error leaves the launcher promise pending and Node returns success.
7898.proposedFix: Reject waitForProcessExit on the original spawn error and remove the alternative listener after settlement.
7898.caveats: Verified on Linux with Node 22 at trusted main, twice. Published nightly, Node 24, historical release, and update pruning were not exercised. Reproduction artifacts are embedded in the HTML under the reports repository policy.
